citation.authors: Bleakley C, McDonough S, Gardner E, Baxter GD et al

record.population: 366 participants in 17 small trials, mainly athletes and active adults (not selected by ancestry)
record.design: Cochrane review of randomised and quasi-randomised trials of cold-water immersion after exercise; ethnicity not reported in the abstract
record.finding: Compared with rest, cold-water immersion reduced muscle soreness at 24, 48, 72 and 96 hours (for example standardised mean difference -0.55 at 24 hours). The authors rate study quality as low; the trials varied in temperature, duration and exercise, and most did not report active surveillance of adverse events.
record.note: tier_variant trial-other-population. Ethnicity of participants not reported in the abstract.
